subject: SIG request: vulnerability evidence + temporary SLA bridge / escrow instructions
messages:
From: Alice Morris <alice.morris@fincloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@fincloud.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG / VM evidence + SLA ask for CVE-2026-XXXX

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the brief call earlier — fincloud is collecting SIG/CAIQ evidence ahead of our procurement committee next week. Two asks we need to close fast: 

1) A signed attestation that Redwood will remediate critical CVEs affecting the inference runtime within 30 days of public disclosure (we understand vendor constraints; please list any exclusions).
2) An evidence package showing most recent authenticated scan cadence (last 90 days), sample triage notes, and proof of remediation for CVE-2026-XXXX (this CVE impacted the model runtime library — our security team flagged it).

Because the downstream vendor has indicated a 45-day patch window for one of the dependent components, our procurement team would like a temporary SLA bridge: are you able to accept a one-time exception to 45 days with an escrow/rollback commitment and a DocuSign attestation? We can route the DocuSign and procurement paperwork once Redwood confirms the technical evidence path.

I've attached Fincloud's SIG template to make mapping simpler. Can you please confirm next steps and timeline by EOD?

Best,
Alice Morris
Senior Information Security Manager
Fincloud

Attachment: Fincloud_SIG_Template.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morris <alice.morris@fincloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, procurements@fincloud.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / VM evidence + SLA ask for CVE-2026-XXXX

Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can support a one-time SLA bridge to 45 days provided we include the vendor patch constraints and an escrow/rollback plan in the attestation. Proposed next steps: 

- I will upload a compact evidence index (scan cadence, sample manifests, remediation proof) for your team to review — attaching the first pass.
- Kimberly (cc'd) will prepare a formal attestation PDF and the DocuSign envelope with the exception language and escrow instructions.
- If leadership sign-off is required for the SLA exception, I'll loop Laura and get approval.

Target timeline: 48 hours for the evidence index, 72 hours for the attestation + DocuSign (subject to legal review). If that works I can open a DocuSign and share the link.

Jordan Blake | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0122

Attachment: redwood_vm_evidence_index_v1.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morris <alice.morris@fincloud.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / VM evidence + SLA ask for CVE-2026-XXXX — attestation draft

Hi Alice, Jordan — putting the attestation and scope details on the table. 

Summary (short): Redwood confirms a standard operating SLA of 30 days for remediation of critical CVEs discovered in our managed inference runtime components. For CVE-2026-XXXX specifically, the vendor has communicated a 45-day patch delivery for the dependency we consume; because of that, Redwood is prepared to accept a one-time temporary SLA bridge to 45 days for this CVE with the following binding mitigations: 

- Compensating controls: we will enable an emergency mitigation (runtime sandboxing + additional monitoring) within 24 hours of disclosure and provide telemetry proof.
- Rollback/escrow: we will provide an escrowed rollback artifact for the affected runtime revision and maintain it for 180 days post-remediation.
- Refund/credit: for SLA miss tied to this exception, Redwood will provide a one-time account credit equal to estimated three days of premium usage (details to be included in DocuSign).

Attached are: redwood_cve_closure_attestation_20261102.pdf and scan_manifest_nov2026.csv (sample of authenticated scan runs and triage notes). The attestation is intentionally explicit about the conditional 45-day bridge, vendor caveats, and required signature block for both parties.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/Envelope12345 (I will prepare the envelope this morning).

If Fincloud would like an additional detailed scan export, we can include a salted archive for forensic review under an NDA. 

Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_cve_closure_attestation_20261102.pdf; scan_manifest_nov2026.csv

1) The escrow artifact is in place before signature.
2) The compensating controls are deployed and telemetry proof is provided within 24 hours of signing.
3) Legal signs off on the credit wording.

Please include internal ref SLA-EXC-2026-11-01 in the DocuSign envelope and route to me for visibility. Laura

Thanks — this looks good. We have two quick asks before routing to procurement: 

1) Please add a short clause in the attestation referencing Fincloud's required forensic export (only accessible under NDA) — language should be two sentences.
2) Confirm whether the escrow artifact will be delivered to a neutral escrow (we prefer IronVault) or directly to Fincloud's legal mailbox.

Once those two items are in, procurement will sign the DocuSign and return the fully executed copy.

Best,
Alice

Fincloud
